changes.before: Requires PUCT/ERCOT large-load planning and interconnection standards; applies to large loads at a default 75 MW single-site threshold; addresses interconnection studies, cost allocation, co-location, and emergency curtailment
changes.after: Directs PUCT standards for new or expanded ERCOT interconnections exceeding a single-site demand threshold of 75 MW unless PUCT determines a lower threshold necessary. Other provisions have distinct scopes: Section 39.170(b) uses at least 75 MW, while Section 39.170(a) applies to certain transmission-voltage loads interconnected after 2025-12-31. Also addresses studies, cost recovery, financial commitments, qualifying co-location and conditional curtailment.
